notes.title: New game HASTE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we've previously posted about our upcoming game HASTE since we think there's some overlap between Clustetruck players and people who'd enjoy another "go fast - die a lot" type of game!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1796470/HASTE_Broken_Worlds/][h3]HASTE is finally out on Steam! [/h3][/url]

[previewyoutube=dHoXrWIawxY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*] Third-person high-speed running gameplay
[*] 10 Shards, each featuring a collection of procedurally generated levels that must be completed without fail to advance to the next Shard
[*] Items and Challenge levels that let you customise your build for each attempt to clear a Shard
[*] Spectacular biomes and 4 different bosses to discover
[*] 4 abilities to master
[*] An unlockable endless mode
[*] A story to explore and a lovable cast of characters to befriend
[/list]

notes.title: Free demo for our next game HASTE!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone! 

Long time no see, we can't believe Clustertruck is turning 9 years old this year! 

We're currently working to release a new game and thought that if you like Clustertruck you may also like HASTE: Broken Worlds! [/b]

HASTE: Broken Worlds is a high-speed third-person running game, set in a collapsing universe. Race through a variety of worlds, master your movement and use items and abilities to progress through each level before it falls apart around you. The game consists of ten Shards, each featuring a collection of procedurally generated levels that must be completed without fail to unlock the next. You’ll encounter challenges and characters on your journey, seeking answers about what lies behind the destruction, and how to escape it!
[previewyoutube=voVRktkV62A;full][/previewyoutube]

It has more of a roguelike structure compared to Clustertruck's levels on levels approach but we think some may enjoy it anyway!

[b]We have a free demo out on Steam for you to try as part of Steam Next Fest: [/b]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2940200/HASTE_Broken_Worlds_Demo

Enjoy!

Then it’ll introduce static obstacles, then swinging hammers, lasers, plummeting… it gets messy. notes.title: Clustertruck Launching Tomorrow, TwitchCon Launch Detailed
notes.notes:
[img]http://imgur.com/e5phOnE.png[/img]

Can you believe that Clustertruck is launching tomorrow? We sure can't. The guys at Landfall are hard at work making a final launch build, while the tinyBuild side will have to drive a truck around San Diego today. 

[h1]Exciting launch features[/h1]

I want to take a moment and talk about some of the exciting features we'll have on launch

[list][*][b]Replays[/b] allow you to see ghosts of players who have beaten levels faster than you. I found myself playing levels over and over again chasing ghosts of other players. While the truck simulation is different between you and the ghost, it's still amazing to see what others have been able to pull off. 

[*][b]Workshop Level Editor[/b] allows you to create, share, and play user levels. We've seen some fantastic -- and unintentional uses -- of the editor, and are excited to see what you come up with. The weird part for me is that you can pay great parkour levels that don't require trucks. 

[*][b]A full-on Single Player Campaign with tons of replayability[/b] -- you've seen the levels, and there's a lot of them. Aside from the replays feature that puts ghosts in for you to compete against, there are a ton of modifiers and abilities at your disposal. [/list]

We've already talked about Twitch Integration in a previous post, and there's a reason we're doing it. Because everything ends up at TwitchCon!

[h1]TwitchCon Launch Event[/h1]

If you're in San Diego, come by and take a picture of yourself next to a giant truck we're parking in the middle of the San Diego Convention Center. 

There's a slight problem though. 

We need to park it there tomorrow in the morning. You need to get transportation into the hall before everyone starts building up. In order to do that, the truck needs to have only 1/4 of its gas tank. 

The problem is that when you pick up a rental truck, it always comes with a full tank of gas. 

This means we need to pick up the truck in an hour from this post, and drive around until there's 1/4 of a gas tank left. We figured we'd use this opportunity to visit all the touristy places in San Diego and make pictures of.. a truck. We'll be livestreaming this on Facebook from my phone, join us at http://facebook.com/tinybuildgames if you want to see what it's like marketing indie games. 

[h1]Last Chance to Save 20%[/h1]

You have just over 24 hours from this post to save 20% on Clustertruck if you haven't done so already. The game unlocks tomorrow around 10am PST. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/397950/

notes.title: Twitch Integration Details: Exploding Trucks, Earthquakes and more
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.giphy.com/26ufeFntRrsCsFJBu.gif[/img]

Good news everyone, 

Clustertruck will have Twitch Integration featuring plenty of ridiculously insane modifiers. 

[h1]It works very similar to how Party Hard did it:[/h1]

[list][*]Authorize via Twitch OAUTH
[*]An in-game UI appears and chatbot notifies of voting periods
[*]Chat votes on #1, #2, #3[/list]

Once the odds are in, an event is chosen based on the provided odds. It means that a lower percentage event might win. The casting vote user will be highlighted in the game itself. 

[h1]Possible Events[/h1]

- Exploding Trucks
Trucks explode all over the place.
- Inverted
Everyone loves inverted controls, right?
- Laser Trucks
The trucks have lasers. Yes, the same ones that insta-kil you. Good luck.
- Earthquake
The ground starts to shake, because the game is too easy.
- Bouncy Trucks
As a kid, I always wanted a bouncy castle.
- MinMax
You’re going to love this one. Won’t spoil it for you.
- Low Gravity
The gravity is low and you can jump higher.
- Double Gravity
Everyone is suddenly very heavy.
- Thin Trucks
The trucks lost some weight and fall on their sides.
- Fat Trucks
The trucks got some weight on them and are wider than usual.

We are sending out media keys today and look forward to watching streamers play this! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/397950/

notes.title: Totally Accurate Battle Simulator Pre-Alpha Now Included
notes.notes:
[img]http://imgur.com/cg6VkEI.gif[/img]

[h1]Pre-Purchasing Clustertruck gets you the Pre-Alpha of Totally Accurate Battle Simulator[/h1]

The guys at Landfall Games have been working hard on Totally Accurate Battle Simulator, and we thought it would be a good opportunity to include the Pre-Alpha for it with Clustertruck. 

By Pre-Purchasing Clustertruck you get access to the Pre-Alpha that'll be updated until its November Open Alpha launch. This Pre-Alpha doesn't get you the full TABS game. 

This is a way to thank everyone for pre-purchasing Clustetruck, and a way for you to pass the time while you wait for the release on September 27th. 

The main benefit the dev team gets is the ability to update the build for TABS remotely instead of sending everyone e-mails with updates -- surely issues will pop-up before the build can be freely shared. 

So enjoy the TABS Pre-Alpha and see you all in Clustertruck on September 27th!

- If you already pre-purchased Clustertruck, check your Steam library for Totally Accurate Battle Sim. It's playable now. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/397950/

notes.title: Clustertruck Alpha speedrun event!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/4LJAU0N.png[/img]

Hello everyone, the first Clustertruck Alpha speedrun event hosted by /u/PurelyOriginal is nearly here!

[h1]When will it start?[/h1]
5th of March 1pm/13:00 PST (UTC -8) [url=http://itsalmo.st/#starting_3bJTJ] Countdown[/url]

[h1]How do I join?[/h1]

You'll need the current Alpha build, download it from [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/HighwayFightSquad/comments/44rvrs/clustertruck_0151_update_movement_overhaul/] here[/url]

To join you'll need a speedrunslive [url=http://www.speedrunslive.com/SpeedRunsLive] account[/url] you can make an account by following this [url=http://www.speedrunslive.com/faq/#join] guide[/url]. You'll also need [url=http://livesplit.github.io/downloads//] Livesplit[/url]. 

To join the race you need to right click the timer and hover over race. The race will hopefully be there before it starts. should look like [url=http://i.imgur.com/R8UeMMt.png] this[/url]

[h1]How do I prepare?![/h1]

You can prepare by watching the runs of the top times at the speedrun [url=http://www.speedrun.com/Clustertruck] leaderboard[/url] or watch the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WTl-6I4O6-w]tutorial[/url] by the host himself

[h1]Prizes[/h1]

[b]1st Place[/b]: 1 Clustertruck key, 1 Airbrawl key,1 Squarebrawl key and a msPaint drawing of your choice by PurelyOriginal

[b]2nd Place[/b]: 1 Airbrawl Key, 1 Squarebrawl key and a msPaint drawing of your choice by PurelyOriginal

[b]3rd Place[/b]: 1 Airbrawl key and a msPaint drawing of your choice by PurelyOriginal

[b]4th Place[/b]: 1 Squarebrawl Key and a msPaint drawing of your choice by PurelyOriginal

[b]Participation[/b]: Everyone who parcticipates will recieve a msPaint drawing of your own choice by PurelyOriginal

[h1]How do I claim my prize?[/h1]

After the event there will be a link here to a google form, fill that out with proof that you were a winner, we prefer video proof but anything that does show you were the winner is good.

Link: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1vcYE-1b632s8Drhn6ZDXTC0OruxLPpi58V6suiL5cFA/viewform] here[/url]

Congratulations to everyone who won!

[h1]What to expect[/h1]

This is the first speedrun event so expect some hiccups, but if all goes well more events will come.


With kind regards,
Hddn

notes.title: Reddit, Forum and Discord!
notes.notes:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RKtexjH.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 
  
[h1]Clustertruck Reddit[/h1]
Check out our subreddit if you want to keep up with what we're working on: [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/HighwayFightSquad/] Reddit[/url]

[h1]Cluster Truck Forums[/h1]
We also have a forum where you can discuss the game: [url=https://forum.playclustertruck.com/] Forum Page[/url]

Here you can find the latest Clustertruck related info and talk to some cool people!

All feedback we get is also forwarded to the forums, so if you got a cool new idea, it might be a good idea to check the forums beforehand.


[h1]Clustertruck Discord[/h1]
The game also has a discord server!  
Q) What is discord?
A) Think of a mix between skype, msn, teamspeak and steam chat but then have it working!
Q) Where can I find this discord?
A) Right here! [url=https://discord.gg/0mmEn8sRPpUikavZ] Discord[/url]


With kind regards,
~Nry
